landing.about: Medioo — a product of Elioo Health
landing.bag.h: Twenty years of reports in a polythene bag. Who’s to say which one matters?
landing.bag.p: Three hospitals, five doctors, handwritten prescriptions. You’re in Dhaka; she’s back home. Ask on the phone and the answer never changes:
landing.c.h: Don’t take our word for it. Check.
landing.c.p: Every value Medioo reads is shown beside a crop of the original paper. If it misreads something, you’ll catch it.
landing.collab: Working in this space? Write to us:
landing.f.levels: Every document gets one of three marks:
landing.f.msg: There are three medicines here. The blood-pressure one, once in the morning. The diabetes one at lunch and at night, after food. The one for acidity in the morning, on an empty stomach. The doctor wants a creatinine test and another visit in three months.
landing.f.p: Handwritten or printed, from any hospital. Medioo reads it, explains it in plain Bangla in text and voice, and tells you how urgent it is.
landing.f.voice_p: You can forward the voice note to your parents. They can listen even if they can’t work the phone.
landing.fine: Free during the pilot. No app to install.
landing.foot: Medioo is an information and record-keeping service, not medical advice. In an emergency, go to the nearest hospital without delay.
landing.h.cap: No one had to ask. Medioo sent this on its own.
landing.h.msg: Your mother’s creatinine has crept up across her last three reports: {0}. In June the doctor asked to see her again in three months. That’s now. Worth a visit this week.
landing.h.note: In the product these messages are in Bangla, with voice. They’re translated here.
landing.h.reply: Explained and filed. The doctor asked to see her again in three months. I’ll remind you when it’s time.
landing.h1: It remembers every report your family has had. And it speaks up first.
landing.not.p: It doesn’t diagnose. It doesn’t prescribe. It doesn’t replace a doctor. It remembers, explains, and reminds. Decisions stay with you and the doctor.
landing.promise.2: They are never sold to anyone.
landing.promise.3: Ask, and everything is deleted within 24 hours.
landing.sub: Send a photo of any prescription or lab report. Medioo explains it in plain Bangla, files it, and messages you first when a follow-up is due, a medicine changes, or a number starts drifting.
landing.yr.1.msg: The doctor asked to see her in three months. That’s next week.
landing.yr.2.msg: The blood-pressure medicine isn’t on the new prescription. Worth confirming with the doctor that this was intended.
landing.yr.3.msg: Your father’s HbA1c has gone from 7.1 to 8.2 in a year. Show the doctor all three reports next time. I’m lining them up for you.
landing.yr.4.msg: Nothing has come in for your father in two months. Everything all right?
landing.yr.lede: One chat, over one year. Medioo sent every message below without being asked.
landing.z.h: Start with the report photo that’s already on your phone.
landing.z.p: We’re in pilot with a small number of families. It’s free.
